name: Thin Echo
description: Cast a faint copy of the user's presence one pace to the side so that an opponent's soul-sense reads the user in two spots.

name: Held Likeness
description: Hold the cast likeness steady before the user's chest so that a soul-strike spends itself on the likeness and not on the user.

name: Pace Double
description: Send the echo one pace ahead and draw the user's awareness into it so the user crosses the gap in a single stride.

name: Trailing Shade
description: Let a thin shade trail behind the user and report any soul that draws near from that side.

name: Quiet Guise
description: Draw a plain guise over the user's own soul-signature so that an opponent's soul-sense slides past the user without settling.

name: Rattling Echo
description: Snap the echo against an opponent's guard so the small shock rattles the soul behind it.

name: Cast Image
description: Throw a flat image of the user a few paces off so that an opponent's eyes and soul-sense are drawn to it.

name: Pale Double
description: Turn the pale double into the path of an incoming soul-bolt so that the bolt veers off the user.

name: Swap Echo
description: Slide the user's awareness into the cast image and step out of it a pace to the side.

name: Watching Likeness
description: Leave a still likeness at the user's shoulder to watch the soul-field at the user's back.

name: Nudging Shade
description: Push the shade into an opponent's chest so that a soft jolt of soul force unsettles the stance.

name: Lent Face
description: Lay a borrowed face over the image so that an opponent hesitates and takes it for someone known.

name: Standing Shade
description: Plant a motionless shade before the user so that it takes the first soul-strike aimed at the user.

name: Shade Lunge
description: Drive the shade forward in a short lunge so that the opponent's soul feels a blow the body does not.

name: Split Glance
description: Set the shade to meet the opponent's eyes so that the opponent looks at the shade while the user moves.

name: Near Outline
description: Trace a quick outline around any soul within reach and read how strongly it stands.

name: Follow Shade
description: Fall in behind the advancing shade and cover the first stride at the speed of the shade.

name: Shoulder Cast
description: Leave a hollow cast of the user's shoulder in the way of a soul-lash so that the lash slides off it.

name: Sidelong Form
description: Show a second form from the corner of an opponent's soul-sense so that the opponent turns the wrong way.

name: Bare Double
description: Stand a plain double beside the user with no mark to set it apart so that an opponent cannot tell which is which.

name: Still Figure
description: Keep a still figure fixed between the user and a soul-strike so that the figure takes the weight of it.

name: Waking Image
description: Wake the still image all at once and throw it against an opponent so that the sudden jolt shakes the soul.

name: Soft Imprint
description: Press the double against a nearby soul and read the soft imprint it leaves of that soul's mood.

name: Dull Mantle
description: Wrap the user in a dull mantle of cast presence so that soul-sense finds only a blur where the user stands.

name: Mute Twin
description: Send a mute twin ahead to the chosen spot and take its place with one quiet step.

name: Thin Semblance
description: Draw a semblance so thin that it costs the soul almost nothing yet still draws an opponent's first look.

name: Fading Copy
description: Let the copy fade the instant a soul-strike touches it so that the strike passes through into empty air.

name: Weightless Form
description: Pour the user's presence into a weightless form and let it carry the body a light pace sideways.

name: Gauze Shell
description: Spread a gauze shell round the user that stirs at any soul pressing near.

name: Brushing Wraith
description: Brush a thin wraith across an opponent's face so that a cold flick of soul force makes the opponent flinch.

name: Drifting Effigy
description: Let an effigy drift out from the body on a slow line of soul force and read the souls it passes.

name: Tethered Husk
description: Tie an empty husk to the user's soul by a thread and set it between the user and a soul-strike.

name: Far Visage
description: Show the user's visage at a far point so that an opponent turns to meet a presence that is not there.

name: Slow Proxy
description: Send a slow proxy of the user's blow ahead of the body so that its small shock lands before the real strike.

name: Recalled Image
description: Call the drifted image back to the body and ride its return a pace in the chosen direction.

name: Calling Echo
description: Send an echo out calling in the user's voice so that an opponent's attention follows the sound away from the user.
